claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. Let L(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee.leading. Let R(n) be the sum of the monomials in guarantee.remainder.terms, each coefficient times n^exponent*(log2 n)^log_exponent*(log2 log2 n)^loglog_exponent; an empty sum is zero. There exists N such that C_B2(f_n)>=L(n)-R(n) for every integer n>=N. All remainder coefficients are the exact declared constants. experiments.purpose: Bounded exact B2 identities and potential rows; ordinary and delayed-degree integer roots; general irreducibility, tower fields, design intersections, code linearity and subset enumeration; mixed relative-trace identities, exceptional-subfield nonvanishing, quadratic formulas and polar ranks; actual constant-zero guard evaluations. Finite predicates only, not execution of the nontrivial asymptotic family or certification of universal claims.
